statement: For a free proper discrete group action on a connected noncompact second-countable surface without boundary, inclusion of the compact-open centralizer induces an injection on fundamental groups. A based ambient-null plane homeomorphism loop preserving any connected open subset restricts to a null loop there. Together these statements give an equivariant null-homotopy on every open loop-group orbit whose closed restricted operator image is discrete.
depends_on: Yagasaki, Homotopy types of homeomorphism groups of noncompact 2-manifolds, Theorem 1.1 and compact-pair Lemma 2.1; local point-evaluation sections; ordinary covering lifting criterion and uniqueness; C.29 two-point winding identity; C.30 actual free proper closed image with its restriction kernel
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; discrete-closure open-orbit reduction for C.12
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None: discreteness is required in the proper-action topology, and the original operator restriction kernel is explicitly retained.
notes: The quotient is proved to be an actual regular surface covering. Its sphere and projective-plane cases cannot have noncompact connected total space; a plane quotient forces the trivial covering. In all other cases the point-fixing identity homeomorphism group is contractible, so evaluation is pi1-injective. The complete disk downstairs lifts on O times D2; inverse families, exact boundary agreement, and commutation with every deck operator follow by uniqueness of covering lifts. The plane/annulus restriction exceptions are detected by the exact two-point winding map. C.33 subsequently gives all positive-dimensional intrinsic open-orbit contractions; C.34 proves nonopen continuity; C.35 and C.36 give the exact extension obstruction and compatible finite-union dimension-two construction. The covering proof itself supplies no uniform frontier estimate, and the remaining global requirements are kept in C.12.
